input: Set up a tip jar on my music streaming profile

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Different streaming platforms (Spotify, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, etc.) have completely different methods — or no native tip jar at all — which determines whether a built-in feature or a third-party tool is needed.
Knowing whether fans are primarily local, global, or a niche community affects which payment tools are accessible and appropriate (e.g., PayPal vs. Ko-fi vs. regional options).
Whether the user already has a payment account (PayPal, Stripe, Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee) determines how much setup work remains before a tip jar can go live.
Some tip jar services take a percentage cut or have payout minimums; knowing the user's tolerance for fees shapes which service to recommend.

The user may prefer a simple link (e.g., PayPal.me), a branded page (Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee), or a recurring-support model (Patreon) — these are meaningfully different experiences for both artist and fan.

keyUnknowns.axis: success criteria / what done looks like
keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Success could mean a link live on the profile within hours, or a fully branded page with custom amounts and thank-you messages — the bar sets the scope of work.
The user needs to be able to edit their profile bio or links section; confirming they have account access and know where to add a link determines the immediate first action.

gold.taskTitle: Set up a tip jar on music streaming profile
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to add a tipping mechanism to their music streaming profile so fans can send them money directly.

questions.title: Which streaming platform is your music profile on?
questions.description: Identify the specific platform (e.g., Spotify, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, YouTube Music, Audiomack) to determine what tip jar options are natively supported or linkable.

questions.title: Do you already use a payment service like PayPal or Ko-fi?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing payment or tipping account set up, which determines how much account-creation work is needed before the tip jar can go live.

questions.title: What tip jar tool or style appeals most to you?
questions.description: Gauge whether the user wants a simple payment link (PayPal.me), a branded tipping page (Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee), or a subscription model (Patreon), as these require very different setups.

questions.title: Where are most of your fans or listeners located?
questions.description: Determine the geographic spread of the user's audience to recommend payment tools that are widely accessible and supported in those regions.

questions.title: How much of a fee per tip are you willing to accept?
questions.description: Understand the user's tolerance for transaction or platform fees, which directly narrows down the best tipping service to use.

questions.title: What does a successful tip jar setup look like to you?
questions.description: Clarify the end-state expectation — a bare link live today, a fully designed page with custom tip amounts, or automated thank-you messages — to calibrate the scope of effort.
questions.coversAxis: success criteria / what done looks like

questions.title: Can you currently edit the bio or links section of your profile?
questions.description: Confirm the user has the access and permissions needed to add a tip jar link to their profile, since some platforms restrict editing to verified or paid accounts.
